pair.title: Connect your pellet stove
pair.subtitle: Duepi EVO board with the original WiFi module (myDPRemote).
pair.code_hint: Printed on the WiFi module box and shown in myDPRemote settings. It is stored on your Homey only.
pair.error_host: Please enter the server or bridge address.

settings.title: Temperature sensors
settings.intro: Choose, for each role, any temperature sensor of your Homey. Leave a role empty if you do not have a suitable sensor.
settings.stale_desc: A sensor whose value has not changed for this long is ignored.
settings.saved: Saved. The new sensors are used immediately.
settings.ignore_off: Ignore when the device is off (e.g. air conditioner)
settings.need_comfort: Please choose at least the comfort sensor.
settings.role_comfort_desc: Temperature the targets refer to (e.g. living-room station).
settings.role_comfort2_desc: Averaged with the comfort sensor using the weight below.
settings.role_regulation_desc: Sensor of the thermostat that drives the stove (e.g. Netatmo).
settings.role_outdoor_desc: In open air, out of the sun if possible.
settings.role_outdoorBackup_desc: Used when the reference fails; its offset is learnt and corrected.
settings.role_forecast_desc: Provides the minimum expected over the next 6 hours.
settings.forecast_desc: Météo-France (AROME model, 1.5 to 2.5 km grid) via Open-Meteo, free and without an account. The Homey location, rounded to about 1 km, is sent to Open-Meteo once an hour. The forecast device above is used as fallback.
